# 19 — Frontier Capstones

Attempt these without opening their topic chapters.  Allow 3–5 team-hours per
problem, write the proposed algebraic object before coding, and record the
coefficient domain and failure probability alongside the complexity.

1. [make 1 — ABC278 Ex](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc278/tasks/abc278_h)
2. [Long Binary String — CF1698G](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1698/G)
3. [Lights Out on Connected Graph — ARC105 F](https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc105/tasks/arc105_f?lang=en)
4. [Degree Harmony — ABC412 G](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc412/tasks/abc412_g?lang=en)
5. [Chinese Elephant Chess — QOJ 60](https://qoj.ac/problem/60)
6. [Grafy — QOJ 11139](https://qoj.ac/problem/11139)

For each, require a postmortem with: recognition clue, algebraic model,
preconditions, target complexity, randomized error bound if any, and the
smallest brute-force oracle that could have caught the first bug.
